corrections.reason: The printed glyph in 'ተጠሩ' ('were called', translating Ge'ez 'ተጸውዖቶሙ') is clearly the three-legged Fidel ጠ, which was misread as ጸ.
Standardize the Ethiopic full stop ። at the end of the line instead of two separate word-space colons.
Translating Ge'ez 'ወዓሊ ዘመስፍን' (the centurion's/official's servant), the printed Amharic word is clearly 'ባሪያ' (servant), where 'ሪ' with ink bleed was misread as 'ንድ'.
The first dental in 'የባልቴቲቱን' ('of the widow', translating 'መበለት') has the 5th-order loop (ቴ) on the right leg, and the punctuation at the end of the line is ፤.
